title: M2-D headline counts are conditional on the same-second tie order of the replay and this is not disclosed in the M2-D report
evidence: [RAW][IMPL] tie_sensitivity_result.json: replay of the raw ledger under (ts,row) [engine], sells-first and buys-first. Opening body units 626,765 / 626,830 / 626,680; closing body units 540,250 / 540,315 / 540,165; items 36,784 / 36,786 / 36,780; W1 links 42,777 / 42,778 / 42,776; W1_S60 65,228 / 65,230 / 65,221; W3 body residual 66,055 / 66,120 / 65,970. impact: Tiny (<= 0.014 % of body units, <= 4 items, <= 7 links) but the exact headline integers (626,765; 540,250; 66,055) are convention-conditional facts, presented without that label.
proposed_fix: State the tie-order convention beside the M2-D headline integers and add the measured sensitivity table (above) to the report.

title: W3 weight column is not pinned by any existing test (mutant M19 survives all 33 tests)
evidence: Mutation M19 (W3 weight = matched / body_qty) -> 33 passed on the mirror; own reference detects it on the full ledger (links:W3 field diffs). INSPECTED: test_real_outputs_reproduce_the_committed_manifest hashes the committed files (not regenerated output) and compares only the W1 row count to the live run, so W3 columns are not compared to a live run anywhere.
impact: A wrong W3 weight would pass the suite; weight is a published column of wing_body_links_W3.
proposed_fix: Assert W3 weight == queue_matched_units / wing_qty in the unequal-quantity W3 test.
proposed_test: extend test_W3_is_arithmetic_conserves_units...: for each segment assert weight == pytest.approx(units / wing_qty); add a W3 case with wing qty != body qty.

title: Closing-level role scope: stop-closed bodies and non-h_-closed h_-opened wings are excluded; magnitude by episode origin not reported
evidence: [RAW][IMPL] scope_probe_result.json: of 95,485 units of short episodes closed by s_, 59,065 were opened only by num (short bodies by the opening-tag rule) and are absent from closing bodies (540,250); long episodes opened only by h_ but closed by num / s_ / v_ = 67,070 / 22,075 / 25,500 = 114,645 units are absent from closing wings. The report gives exclusions by closing tag and says stop-closed bodies are omitted, but not these origin-based magnitudes.
impact: Closing-level coverage numbers (105,060 body units without wing; 105,750 unmatched wing units) are not comparable with opening-level numbers; reader could read them as population coverage.
proposed_fix: Add the origin-based table to section 6 and label closing-level coverage as closing-tag-scope only.
proposed_test: none needed beyond a report-number regression of the table.

title: Same-contract and non-OTM wing/body candidate links are retained unflagged
evidence: [RAW][IMPL] real_checks_result.json: same-instrument wing/body links: W1 6, W1_S60 7, W3 8; links with wing not further OTM: W1 24, S60 32, W3 27 (of 42,777 / 65,228 / 12,096). A long and a short in the same contract cannot be a spread leg pair; the report discloses the 99.9 % OTM share only.
impact: Negligible numerically; matters for any later reading of candidates as protective pairs.
proposed_fix: Add a column same_instrument / otm_distance_le_0 flag; keep links (no filtering).
proposed_test: synthetic: long h_ then close then short num same contract in one minute -> flagged.
